renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D phase-locked material ring
primitiveBudget: one generated radial material ring, twelve produced segments, four rim pulse sites, one mutable central aperture, and four liftable phase slips
commitThreshold: press one rim site for at least 240ms and release during phase 0.34–0.49 of the deterministic cycle
memoryRule: the hand path never becomes a mark; an accepted release re-produces segment radii, widths, skew, core radius, and aperture; four phase slips persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch presses a rim site and releases in the quiet window; ArrowUp/Right/Down/Left selects, Enter/Space performs the deterministic pulse; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: wash field, folded sheet, and relief tablet -> one radial material ring with an actual mutable aperture
compositionRupture: full-field wash, portrait sheet, and compact horizontal relief -> centred circular body with four cardinal pulse sites and twelve unequal radial segments
encounterRupture: ordered passage, simultaneous chord, and reversible lift -> phase-locked press-and-release with no spatial stroke
temporalRupture: remote bloom, local fold, and persistent cut -> discrete timing window that decides whether geometry may be re-produced
mediumRupture: wash bands, fold planes, and relief ribs -> p5.js Canvas 2D radial segments, produced aperture, seam grain, and phase state
changedRule: Pressure is inert until release lands in a deterministic quiet phase; only then does the material re-produce its actual segments and central aperture.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one dark warm ring of twelve unequal segments. A valid pulse changes segment geometry and the central opening; four accepted slips remain visible as cumulative form, not colour or readout.
falsifier: Delete if a short or mistimed pulse changes the body, if only colour/readout moves, if segment/aperture geometry is unchanged, if later slips reset, if lifting is inexact, or if the blind ring reads as a generic radial diagram.
deletionCondition: Delete v051 if timing is only explanatory prose or the blind ring is merely a recoloured wash, sheet, or relief.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
